purpose: Catalytic identity discovery/confirmation development, calibration and reserved final validation; no complex or molecular-function truth inferred.
rules: HydDB author-curated catalytic identity is a separate evidence tier from per-protein biochemical activity; predicted subgroup, donor, direction and physiology never become experimental truth.

Reviewed UniProt product/domain selection is recorded per accession; small/partner subunits, maturation proteins, uncharacterized products and spurious keyword matches are not positive catalytic truth.
Full proteins and cropped H-domains sharing an accession inherit the same split and never count as independent biological examples.
Exact normalized protein sequences are deduplicated, with every source accession, raw sequence hash and provenance retained. Cys/Sec are distinct in raw hashes; only leakage BLAST normalizes U to C.

Homolog components use undirected single-linkage BLAST identity >=70% over >=70% of the shorter sequence. One best local HSP is used; this operational definition cannot exclude every remote domain relationship.
All current reference proteins, complete source translations, previously examined PDB chains and all 14 Hadar pilot proteomes are exposure controls, never new independent test positives.
Current NCBI genus taxon IDs, including renamed taxa, determine deterministic development/calibration/final ownership. Unknown or conflicting taxonomy is quarantined.

A homolog component matching prior exposure or an exposed genus is quarantined as reference_overlap. Other components spanning different genus owners are quarantined as split_bridge. Quarantined sequences must not be used for new model selection while a related genus is reserved.
Source label conflicts, absent accession metadata and length discrepancies are retained for review and excluded from sealed final evaluation; they are not silently removed as prediction errors.

No candidate prediction or final-set performance may be inspected before split hashes are frozen. The final partition remains unused until model and thresholds are fixed using development and calibration alone.
Report sequence units, homolog components, genera and evidence tiers separately; sequences within one component are not independent biological replicates.
